# Latent MoE efficiency versus capacity: a scaled experiment

Six actual trained toy models on Mac CPU, three seeds, 1200 updates. Full 32768 vs latent 10240 parameters; normalized test MSE .571543 vs .663077; output rank 64 vs 16. A full-width random teacher favors full-width capacity. Fixed external routing, ReLU, no shared experts or human data; not native Nemotron or an official benchmark. No Manager promotion. Official BF16/NVFP4 manifests 1.121 TB / 352.3 GB; native run delegated under existing resource gates.

[Code and evidence](https://github.com/Daisuke134/anicca-ops/tree/chatgpt/nemotron-h12-roadmap-20261127/files/research-artifacts/nemotron-h12-2026-11-27)

Sources: [NVIDIA Ultra](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/nemotron/Nemotron-3-Ultra/), [architecture](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Nemotron/blob/main/skills/nemotron-ultra/paper/architecture.md).
